name: Cross-Entropy Method (CEM)
tagline: Top-k elite sampler: Gaussian shoot, evaluate via learned value, refit (mean, std) to elite trajectories — no temperature weighting.
diff_from_baseline: Rubinstein & Kroese 2004. Classical importance-sampling-by-elites planner; the simplest refit-on-top-k variant compared against MPPI's softmax-weighted update.

name: MPPI (default TD-MPC2)
tagline: TD-MPC2 default: MPPI with softmax-weighted elite update on the learned value, Gumbel-sampled action from elites; matches the original TD-MPC2 planner.
diff_from_baseline: Williams et al. 2017 (ICRA), used as the default planner in Hansen et al. 2024 TD-MPC2. Information-theoretic MPC: exponentiated-value soft-elite update.

name: iCEM (improved CEM)
tagline: CEM with temporally-correlated (colored) noise, kept elites across iterations, and per-iteration noise decay for refinement.
diff_from_baseline: Pinneri et al. 2020 (iCEM, CoRL). Adds three sample-efficiency tricks to CEM: colored (Beta-decay) noise, elite carry-over, and noise annealing.
